name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.network.NetworkTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. Android creates this BigBrother provider during app startup; it initializes the local store used by the diagnostic network history.
disableEffect: BigBrother's network history will not initialize, so diagnostic request records may be unavailable; the app's network traffic is unaffected.
